Trace, implement and test: 04.02.Minimum Height Tree

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(NULL), right(NULL) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    TreeNode* sortedArrayToBST(vector<int>& nums) {
        auto dfs = [&](this auto&& dfs, int l, int r) -> TreeNode* {
            if (l > r) {
                return nullptr;
            }
            int mid = l + r >> 1;
            return new TreeNode(nums[mid], dfs(l, mid - 1), dfs(mid + 1, r));
        };
        return dfs(0, nums.size() - 1);
    }
};
